I will not change or comment on the official deterministic score. Below are concise, concrete observations and recommendations based only on the provided sanitized context.

1) Top architecture risks (concrete observations)
- Engine observability and test gaps
  - Evidence: CURRENT_STATE / Discovery: "Missing: engine unit tests, production observability".
  - Risk: production failures in the discovery engine (streaming NDJSON /api/discovery/analyze) could be hard to triage or could silently fail.
- Authentication and multi-tenant safety incomplete
  - Evidence: CURRENT_STATE: "Auth + Neon schema Partial" and "Missing: Hardened production auth gates on all surfaces".
  - Risk: partial auth and DB schema coverage increase blast radius for data exposure or privilege escalation.
- Runtime side-effects during dev/build
  - Evidence: "knowledge:sync on npm run dev / npm run build (maps + warnings refresh automatically)".
  - Risk: build-time network/IO may cause nondeterministic builds, leaks, or slow CI; may expose secrets if not strictly sandboxed.
- Contract drift between UI-safe contracts and engine internals
  - Evidence: UI-safe discovery contract exists at src/lib/discovery/stages.ts; engine exports/re-exports related types from src/engine/discovery/stages.ts.
  - Risk: duplication or drift between engine internals and UI-safe contracts can cause runtime mismatches and break independence rules.
- Mocked core flows create hidden coupling risk
  - Evidence: Strategy / Content
